title: The garden of light
alt: Coloured glass flowers cast delicate shadows beside four lines of exhibition typography.
description: Coloured glass flowers cast delicate shadows beside four lines of exhibition typography.
prompt:
精美复杂的现代艺术展海报，由彩色透明玻璃花朵、弯曲的金属枝条与多层半透明花瓣组成光影花园，阳光在米白背景上投下细腻彩色阴影。高级雕塑摄影，嫩绿、淡粉、柠檬黄与清透蓝，字体与玻璃曲线和谐相融。
Render only the following complete text, with correct clear lettering and natural line breaks: “光的花园” “让颜色，照亮每一天。” “在透明的世界里，看见新的可能。” “玻璃艺术与光影展”. No additional words or tiny pseudo-text. The finished artwork fills the image.
